crossRefs.note: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through…
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

translations.web: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
translations.bsb: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
translations.kjv: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
translations.asv: Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
